title.hinglish: Apne system ki proxy setting check karo

why.en: See whether your machine is already configured to use a proxy. This only reads settings.
why.hinglish: Dekho ki tumhari machine pehle se proxy use karne ke liye configured hai ya nahi. Yeh sirf settings padhta hai.

expect.en: On Windows, “Direct access (no proxy server)” at home, or a proxy address like 192.168.1.5:3128 at an office. On Unix, empty output or http_proxy/https_proxy variables. It varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Windows par ghar mein “Direct access (no proxy server)”, ya office mein 192.168.1.5:3128 jaisa proxy address. Unix par khaali output ya http_proxy/https_proxy variables. Yeh machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

title.en: See the absolute-URL GET and CONNECT in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein absolute-URL GET aur CONNECT dekho

why.en: Requests to a proxy look different from normal ones: the request line holds the full URL, and HTTPS starts with CONNECT.
why.hinglish: Proxy ko jaane wali requests normal se alag dikhti hain: request line mein poora URL hota hai, aur HTTPS CONNECT se shuru hota hai.

expect.en: A GET http://example.com/ request and a CONNECT example.com:443 request, both sent to the proxy on port 3128.
expect.hinglish: Ek GET http://example.com/ request aur ek CONNECT example.com:443 request, dono port 3128 par proxy ko bheji gayi.

why.en: The auth scenario shows the proxy asking for credentials before fetching anything.
why.hinglish: Auth scenario dikhata hai ki proxy kuch bhi fetch karne se pehle credentials maangta hai.

expect.en: A 407 response with Proxy-Authenticate, then a retried request with Proxy-Authorization: Basic ZGFuaXNo… which Wireshark can decode.
expect.hinglish: Proxy-Authenticate ke saath 407 response, phir Proxy-Authorization: Basic ZGFuaXNo… ke saath retry hui request jise Wireshark decode kar sakta hai.

title.en: Fetch a page through a proxy (if you have one)
title.hinglish: Proxy ke zariye page fetch karo (agar tumhare paas ho)

why.en: curl -x sends the request to a proxy you own or are allowed to use. Replace the address with your own proxy; skip this if you have none.
why.hinglish: curl -x request ko aise proxy ko bhejta hai jo tumhara apna ho ya jise use karne ki permission ho. Address ko apne proxy se badlo; agar tumhare paas nahi hai to skip karo.

expect.en: With a proxy running, you see “GET http://example.com/ HTTP/1.1” in the request and Via headers in the reply. Without one, curl reports connection refused.
expect.hinglish: Proxy chalne par request mein “GET http://example.com/ HTTP/1.1” aur reply mein Via headers dikhte hain. Bina proxy ke curl connection refused batata hai.
